acceptanceCriteria: DecodeConfig refuses any repeated member at any depth with a configuration error naming the member path.
Maintained tests cover a repeated top-level member and a repeated member inside a role.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from the beamfall/corvint#652 lane (branch claude/gh652, base 79536edd, head 58f843f2; go1.27.1). Confirmed by reading the code.

internal/tasks/dispatch/config.go DecodeConfig uses encoding/json with DisallowUnknownFields, which still accepts a repeated object member and keeps the last value (for example two `budget` members on one role, or two `roles` arrays). The lane's new budget members refuse repeats, but the outer configuration does not; this predates V1-0937. Expected: a repeated member anywhere in a dispatch configuration is refused as malformed, so an operator never runs a config that differs from what they read. Actual: the last value silently wins.
title: dispatch: DecodeConfig keeps the last value of a repeated JSON member instead of refusing it
